test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A vendor bought 12 items for a rupee. How many for a rupee should he sell to gain 20%?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost price of 12 items = 1 rupee.

Gain = 20%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = Cost Price (CP) × (1 + Gain%)

**Calculation:**

CP of 1 item = 1 / 12 rupee

SP of 1 item = CP × (1 + 20/100)

⇒ SP of 1 item = (1 / 12) × (1 + 0.20)

⇒ SP of 1 item = (1 / 12) × 1.20

⇒ SP of 1 item = 1.20 / 12

⇒ SP of 1 item = 0.10 rupee

Number of items sold for 1 rupee = 1 / SP of 1 item

⇒ Number of items sold for 1 rupee = 1 / 0.10

⇒ Number of items sold for 1 rupee = 10

**The correct answer is option 2.**
